falsifier: Tie disclosed histories, disclose latent identity, or change the objective under relaxation.

assumptions: Per-case data refer to the declared feasible baseline. Threshold equality requires nonattainment or another strict argument.
falsifier: Drop positive mass, use an unverified baseline upper enclosure, reverse a weight sign, or accept exclusion at an attained equality.

assumptions: Projection coverage, common objective, appropriate sign and original weights; deterministic history policies.
falsifier: Center on one fitted policy or center only across fixed commands while an adaptive policy selects by observation.

assumptions: Uniform across all admissible decisions; stage bounds aggregated once per chronology.

assumptions: Observed sufficient state; nominal action then call then recourse then disturbance and observed successor. Budget updates order preserving, terminal sets antitone, common response/dynamics/legality.

assumptions: Frozen public law, six epochs, original positive rational masses, deterministic state and stage commands, costs in one declared unit.
